attr.title: Yarntown
attr.desc: Yarntown is a charming 16-bit, top-down demake that transforms the gothic world of Bloodborne into a retro, Zelda-style action RPG. Explore the pixel-art streets of Yharnam, dodge-roll through danger, and face iconic bosses in fast-paced, challenging combat.
attr.inst: Get the .solarus file for this port by downloading Yarntown from https://solarus-games.org/games/yarntown/, then move it into ports/yarntown.
